# Overview

NSDUH moderation models: Race, Sex (16).

This is one of five split reports for De Young et al., "Graduate school confers
risk for mental illness and suicide." The report bodies share a common renderer
(`_report_body.Rmd`); only the set of models differs between files.

```{r define-models, include=FALSE}
POSTERIOR_OUTPUTS <- "C:/Users/jonas/OneDrive - UW/studies/2026_shackman/grad_mh/data/OUTPUTS"
rds_model <- function(label, filename) list(name = label, path = file.path(POSTERIOR_OUTPUTS, paste0(filename, ".rds")), format = "rds")
rdata_model <- function(label, filename) list(name = label, path = file.path(POSTERIOR_OUTPUTS, paste0(filename, ".RData")), format = "RData")

models_to_report <- list(
  rdata_model("NSDUH: Any MI (Mod: Race)", "nsduh_anymi_12mos_mod_race"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH: Global Health Dich (Mod: Race)", "nsduh_global_health_dich_mod_race"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH: Suicidal Thinking (Mod: Race)", "nsduh_suic_thnk_12mos_mod_race"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH: Suicide Attempt Linear (Mod: Race)", "nsduh_suic_try_12mos_linear_mod_race"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH Matched: Any MI (Mod: Race)", "nsduh_matched_anymi_12mos_mod_race"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH Matched: Global Health Dich (Mod: Race)", "nsduh_matched_global_health_dich_mod_race"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH Matched: Suicidal Thinking (Mod: Race)", "nsduh_matched_suic_thnk_12mos_mod_race"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH Matched: Suicide Attempt Linear (Mod: Race)", "nsduh_matched_suic_try_12mos_linear_mod_race"),


  rdata_model("NSDUH: Any MI (Mod: Sex)", "nsduh_anymi_12mos_mod_sex"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH: Global Health Dich (Mod: Sex)", "nsduh_global_health_dich_mod_sex"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH: Suicidal Thinking (Mod: Sex)", "nsduh_suic_thnk_12mos_mod_sex"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH: Suicide Attempt Linear (Mod: Sex)", "nsduh_suic_try_12mos_linear_mod_sex"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH Matched: Any MI (Mod: Sex)", "nsduh_matched_anymi_12mos_mod_sex"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH Matched: Global Health Dich (Mod: Sex)", "nsduh_matched_global_health_dich_mod_sex"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH Matched: Suicidal Thinking (Mod: Sex)", "nsduh_matched_suic_thnk_12mos_mod_sex"),
  rdata_model("NSDUH Matched: Suicide Attempt Linear (Mod: Sex)", "nsduh_matched_suic_try_12mos_linear_mod_sex")
)
```
